steps: You deliver mail with Teresa and hear the story of her encounter with Donna. Teresa drew numerous maps, and within the old ones, you uncover the recipient's information.
Listen up, everyone! Today's mission is all about deliveries!==B====W== Check your cargo before we roll out. Leaving a package behind would be a disaster!
Understood. Show me the ropes, Teresa!==W== Let's see...==W== Quite a few long-distance drops today. Prep work is definitely key.
You bet! Like that one time I rushed out the door and totally forgot my wallet...==B====W== I couldn't even buy lunch. I almost starved to death, meow!
Letters...==W== Map...==W== Lunchbox...==W== Got 'em all!==B====W== Huh? What was supposed to go in this box again...?==W==
Um... Boss... Teresa is a professional courier, right?==W== I have to be honest, I'm starting to panic a little...
She might be a bit scatterbrained, but she really is a top-notch courier.==W== Just follow her lead.
Meow-aaah! Montana's house is on today's list! We gotta get this to her, fast!
Boss, Iris! We're gonna have to take a shortcut!==W== Follow me!
Wait, Teresa?! Don't just leave us in the dust!
Call this a "shortcut"? It's not even a game trail!==B====W== Where's the fire? Why the rush?
T-Teresa! I know we're in a hurry...==W== Huff... But couldn't you pick ...==W== a path with actual footing?!
It's way faster this way! Trust me! Keep up!
Iris, stay close to her!==W== If we get separated, we're in real danger of getting stranded out here!
Ms. Montana! Post Haste delivery! Letters and medicine, safe and sound, meow!
Oh... That was quick!==W== I can't thank you enough!
We'd just run out... Her symptoms came back last night. I was worried sick...==W== Thank you... You're a lifesaver.
Mission accomplished! That's the Post Haste guarantee!==W== Anytime you're in a pinch, just leave it to us!
I see... It was a package for a sick child.
It was definitely an emergency. Still, a little heads-up would've been nice...
Sorry! Medical deliveries are huge emergencies! I remembered that and my brain just ... went into overdrive.
I actually met the girl on a delivery run a while back.==W== She's such a sweet kid, always looking out for her family!
Thinking about her being in pain... I panicked.
I understand.==W== Well, at least we made it in time.
Hehe. Thanks for keeping up with me, you two.
We're fine. But we've still got deliveries to make. Let's not fall behind.
Boss...!==W== You're right!==W== Let's knock out the rest of these orders!
So you took that shortcut==W== because you knew how urgent the package was.
Bingo!==W== But ... that's not the only reason!==W==
Oh? Do you take "shortcuts" like that often?
Blazing a new trail is an adventure all on its own!
You never know what surprises await on a new route!==B====W== Exotic flowers,==W== unknown birds fluttering by...==W== You might even stumble on a hermit's hideout and make a new friend!==W==
The further you go, the more you find!==W== Isn't that exciting?
Wandering into the unknown... Sounds risky. Aren't you scared?
No sweat! If trouble shows up, I'll just whip out Gram and handle it!
Plus, blazing a trail helps everyone. Enough footsteps turn a rough path into a real road! Then people can travel even further!
And more travelers means more people to carry letters, right? See? Forging new paths solves everything at once!
I suppose I misunderstood your intentions, Teresa.==W== You truly are an exceptional courier!
Hehe, yay! I got praised!==W== Thanks! You're doing a great job today too, Iris! Top-tier courier work!
Come to think of it...==W== I think I first met Donna==W== in a forest just like this...
Mmm—nothing beats a nap up in a tree!==W== All charged up! Time to head out...==W== Huh? Do I hear someone?
This is bad. I think I'm actually lost...==W== What am I gonna do when it gets darker?==W== They say monsters lurk around here...
Why didn't I bring a weapon today of all days...==W== Ugh...==W== So reckless... Am I being dumb?
... Huh?==W== You're not a monster...==W== Who are you?
Name's Teresa!==W== Let me guess... You got lost?
Hi... I'm Donna. I tried to take a shortcut, but got completely turned around the second I stepped into the woods...==W== Embarrassing, but yeah ... definitely lost.
No biggie!==W== Just follow me, I'll get you out!
We made it out...!==W== Thank you! You really saved my hide back there.
I run deliveries through here all the time. It's basically my backyard! Hehe!
Deliveries...?==W== Wait, you work as a "courier" too?
Me too!==W== I'm working as a Courier Trekker myself!
Actually, I was out scouting a new postal route. Wanted to chart a path people don't usually take...==W== But, well, got myself lost.
Right! If the main roads get blocked or damaged, the packages stop moving...==B====W== I figured having more options would make the whole system more reliable...
That's amazing! So cool! I can't believe I found someone who thinks just like me!
Whoaaaa?!==W== Are these ... maps?==W== Did you draw this whole stack yourself?!
If I link up all the possible routes on these... Maybe we can reach even more people!
Teresa! You have to team up with me!
With your help... My dream of connecting all of Nova might actually happen!
You got it! Count me in!
That's all it takes to convince you?!
And that's the story of how I met Donna! Meow!
What are the odds!==W== You stop to help a lost stranger, and it turns out you share the exact same dream.
Fate really brought you two together.
Caught me off guard too!==W== Freesia was already there when I joined. That's how the three of us started Post Haste!
Our dream at Post Haste is simple: help as many people as we can through our deliveries. So while we're out delivering, we're also charting postal routes across the entire continent!
Mapping all of Nova... That's a massive undertaking.
Teresa, you keep those maps in your bag, don't you? May I take a look?
Incredible... The detail here rivals the Chronicles of Nova...==B====W== And look at these shortcuts and backroads... Your map might actually be better than the official ones!
Whoa... How many pages are in here? Have you walked halfway across the continent already?!

Nowhere near close...==W== Hehe, but I did walk all the way from Port Bellin to the City of a Thousand Monoliths on my own two feet!==W== I made sure to mark down pretty much every house and shop along the way!
Hey, is there any chance you marked a house labeled "Howard" somewhere in here?
I've already combed through the maps I'm using... No luck, unfortunately.
Right, checking the map is the first thing anyone would do—==B==wait.==W== No...
The map you're "using"...? Does that mean there are maps you no longer use?
Yup!==W== Roads get wrecked and shops change all the time. I have to keep my maps updated so I don't get lost on a delivery!
Hold on. In that case, maybe we should be looking at your older maps...==W==
Exactly. A "Howard's House" might have existed back then!
Oh!! You're right, meow!==W== How did I miss that...? Hang on, lemme check—
This one,==W== and this one...==W== And check this one too!
Pardon me, let me help you look...==B====W== Howard... Howard...
Found it!==W== It's on the map—look, right here!
Whoa, it actually says "Mr. Howard's House" right there...!==W== We used to walk right past it... I totally forgot, meow...
Thanks to you two, it's all coming back to me, meow!==W== I've gotta tell Donna the second we get back!
Going by the intel we've gathered, this has to be Howard's place.
If the map's right, it's gotta be somewhere around here...
It matches the area from the archives.
A famous family with multi-generational history...
Then it looks like it's the Howard family we're looking for.
Great work, everyone! It's getting late, though. Let's handle the delivery tomorrow.
You've all worked so hard. Tonight calls for a reward! I whipped up a feast! Dig in and eat as much as you want!
Oof... I'm stuffed... Can't eat another bite...
Now that we're all well fed, we're all fueled up for tomorrow!==W==
Donna? Where's she wandering off to this late...?
Oh! Boss? Did I wake you?
I was still up. Strange... I'm not sleepy at all.
I had so much fun tonight! Maybe I'm too excited to sleep.
Your cooking was incredible.==W== Making all that at once... It must have been exhausting.
Not at all! It felt like my family suddenly got a whole lot bigger. I loved every second of it!==W== I love having everyone together, loud and lively.
Back at the start, it was just me delivering the letters.
On my own, there was no way to finish all the deliveries in one run.
I had to split the routes and take them day by day.
Looking back... I have no idea how I managed.
Just thinking about it gives me a headache...
But then Freesia and Teresa came along, and we started Post Haste. Now there's so much more we can achieve.
Through worries and joys alike, we stand together. I'm so happy these days... It actually scares me a little.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Ah! Whoops, that sounded kinda weird, huh?==W== I didn't mean anything deep by it! It's just...
Look, the workload keeps piling up! One person definitely can't deliver it all, right?==W== So what I meant was—flying solo isn't an option anymore!==W== Nope, absolutely not!
Anyway! Gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm off to bed!==W== Nighty-night, Boss!
What was that strange feeling just now...? For a split second, Donna looked like a child on the verge of tears...
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Don't ever want to be alone again, huh...
